'''2010 Canadian Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 24 July 2010, using the [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]] pool. The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2010 Canadian Nationals.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 24 July 2010
* '''Winner:''' —

== Standings ==

The results post lists six players.<ref name="t36877">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36877 2010 Canadian Nationals], forum.starwarsccg.org.</ref> The final was one game on each side. Cole Lepine's light side beat Alex O'Shea's dark side by 4. Alex O'Shea's light side beat Cole Lepine's dark side by 6.
